description: This file defines a singleton pattern implementation in C++, including template classes for singleton management, singleton proxies, and internal list handling. It provides mechanisms for singleton instantiation, registration, and lifecycle management within the WPEFramework Core namespace.

classes.name: Singleton
classes.description: Base class implementing singleton registration and lifecycle management within the WPEFramework Core namespace.

classes.name: SingletonType
classes.description: Template class that implements a thread-safe singleton pattern for a specific type, managing its instantiation and providing access via Instance().

classes.name: SingletonProxyType
classes.description: Template class providing a singleton proxy that wraps another type via a ProxyType, enabling singleton access to proxy objects.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Provides access to the singleton instance, creating it if necessary, with thread safety.

methods.name: ImplementationName
methods.description: Returns the name of the singleton implementation.
